question: Should plugin approval cancellation become a public nullable `plugin.approval.resolved` contract used by all abort-aware waiters, or should this PR stay limited to the before_tool_call path?
rationale: The diff adds a new gateway method and widens the plugin approval resolved event contract, so automation cannot safely decide the permanent public API shape or acceptable narrowness of the fix.

options.title: Complete the shared cancel contract
options.body: Require the PR to cancel all abort-aware plugin approval waiters and make nullable resolved events an explicitly supported approval contract before merge.

options.title: Accept the narrow path
options.body: Allow only before_tool_call cancellation now, but keep the linked issue or a follow-up open for Codex app-server and native hook relay approval cleanup.

options.title: Pause the nullable event contract
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a different terminal cleanup shape that does not widen the resolved decision field to null.

recommendation.title: Complete the shared cancel contract
recommendation.body: Require the PR to cancel all abort-aware plugin approval waiters and make nullable resolved events an explicitly supported approval contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original async requireApproval feature and authored nearby approval-flow hardening, making them the best history-backed owner for the gateway/plugin approval contract choice.
